stationary_markov.law: Stationary two-state chain on strict comparison indicatorX in{0,1}, invariant probabilities1/2,1/2; stay99/100, switch1/100; initial state stationary.

S100_iid_radius_comparison.interpretation: IID comparison only; invalid as a tail certificate for this Markov chain.

stationary_markov.units: Probability, variance of a sample proportion, and equivalent number of independent Bernoulli observations as separately named.
not_to_claim: No Monte Carlo path was simulated.
Finite and asymptotic equivalent counts are not estimated ESS.
The asymptotic count is not an exact finite-S variance identity.
Neither equivalent count may be automatically substituted into an IID tail bound.
No-switch is a lower bound on the relevant failure probability at S100, not its complete distribution.

neutral_coefficient_envelope.law: Algebraic bound for the equality-neutral loss under fixed supplied law, targets, weights and feasible family; illustrative radii are stipulated.
neutral_coefficient_envelope.loss: Equality-neutral strict-reversal error; withholding costtau on target distinctness.
neutral_coefficient_envelope.x: disclosure_fraction=N/M, denotedr only locally; distinct from the Markov lag correlation.
neutral_coefficient_envelope.component_units: Normalized risk-error bounds per possible unordered pair.
neutral_coefficient_envelope.coherent_radius_relation: Delta_d=2*Delta_b andtau<=1/2, so the coarser uniform radiusDelta_b is compatible with coherent reverse-pair construction. This does not assert all component bounds are simultaneously sharp.
neutral_coefficient_envelope.endpoint_law_example: Two units, one criterion: law0 always equal; law1 forward/reverse strict orders each mass1/10 and equality4/5. At r0 absolute all-hold risk difference1/20; at r1 either direction difference1/10.
not_to_claim: Interior grid values are an algebraic envelope, not an attained deterministic action path; for the endpoint two-unit example only r0 or1 is possible.
The plotted envelope is not observed estimation error, model calibration, a sampling confidence band or a trajectory of an optimizer.
The constant2*zeta+eta is a conditional uniform regret ceiling under the proposition assumptions, not attained regret.
neutral_coefficient_envelope.endpoint_common_family: For the two-unit endpoint illustration, evaluate the same three canonical reports under both coefficient arrays without changing the family to a law-specific structural-equality guard. These are fixed-action loss differences, not optimization or guarded-family claims.

precision: Exact rational computation for coordinates and cross-checks; CSV values rounded to18significant decimal digits. IID square-root/log comparison uses Python float and is separately identified.
reproduction: Coordinate derivation is recorded in the private fixture receipt. Future public source packaging must include a portable derivation or declare that plotting regenerates from this accepted coordinate table.
empty_cells: Fields belonging to the other series are blank, not zero.
